name: Tyrion
summary: Inside Stormwind Keep, Tyrion watches the court and aids covert work. The gnome works with Elling Trias to gather intelligence and counter plots against the kingdom.

sections.title: A Quiet Presence in the Keep
sections.body: Tyrion keeps to the halls of Stormwind Keep, watching the palace and staying in touch with contacts beyond official oversight.

sections.title: Shadows and Espionage
sections.body: Elling Trias, a cheese merchant in the Trade District, trusts Tyrion with sensitive matters. Trias runs a discreet information network and sends reliable operatives to Tyrion when the House of Nobles' bureaucracy must be bypassed.

sections.title: Uncovering the Threat
sections.body: Tyrion helps investigators enter guarded places and secure sensitive goods in the city. His work reveals danger within the royal heart of the kingdom, and he warns his allies before an organized strike can threaten Stormwind's leaders.

faq.answer: Tyrion is a gnome operative inside Stormwind Keep. He handles covert work and intelligence gathering beyond the usual royal channels.
Tyrion is inside Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City, watching for agents sent by his trusted contacts.

faq.q: What is his connection to Elling Trias?
faq.answer: Tyrion and Elling Trias are longtime friends and collaborators. Trias gathers whispers through his trade connections and sends reliable adventurers to Tyrion when covert work inside the Keep is needed.
Tyrion is involved in covert operations including 'Infiltrating the Castle', 'Items of Some Consequence', and warning allies during 'The Attack!'.

faq.q: Why is a gnome handling secret operations in the human court?
aliases: why is a gnome in stormwind keep
faq.answer: Gnomes are key allies of the Alliance. Tyrion brings sharp intellect, stealth, and technical resourcefulness to secret work in the human court.

faq.q: What is the nature of the plot Tyrion is investigating?
faq.answer: Tyrion tracks stolen intelligence and hidden plots within the royal court, leading to an armed ambush inside the city.

angles.text: As a gnome, Tyrion shows the subtlety and intellect gnomes bring to Alliance espionage, working beneath the notice of human nobility.
As a rogue involved in Elling Trias's covert work, you can rely on Tyrion as an ally inside Stormwind Keep.
Tyrion's intelligence work helps protect the crown from covert threats in the kingdom's capital.
